purpose: Finish what #4855 started. That pass established that infra/sql/production-rls-policies.sql is applied by no deploy path, and re-pointed V8.3.1's revocation condition at the migration chain accordingly - but it appended the migration to the evidence array instead of replacing the artifact, so the artifact stayed. scripts/security/asvs-decisions.mjs joins every entry of that array into evidence_ref, which means the generated matrix went on presenting a file that reaches no database as evidence that authorization is enforced. Raised by review on #4855 after it had already merged; verified against the generated matrix rather than taken on trust.
requiredInvariants: The verdict does not move. V8.3.1 stays PASS, because this is a defect in what the record cites, not in the control the requirement is about - the same distinction #4855 itself drew when it declined to move the status.
Only the artifact reference is removed. The global guard and the RLS transaction service stay, and so does the migration #4855 added; those three are what the requirement actually rests on.

V8.1.1 is NOT touched. It cites the same artifact and there the citation is legitimate: V8.1.1 is about authorization DOCUMENTATION, and a document need not execute to be one. Removing it there would be the mirror image of the error being fixed here.
No source code changes. No migration. No production, REG.RU, DNS, database or credential mutation. New mandatory cost: 0 RUB.
acceptance: The defect was verified in the generated artifact, not argued from the decisions file: before the change ASVS_MATRIX.csv gave V8.3.1 an evidence_ref containing policies:infra/sql/production-rls-policies.sql; after it, that reference is gone and the remaining three are the guard, the transaction context and the applied migration.
Counts unchanged: PASS 126 / FAIL 93 / NOT_APPLICABLE 88 / NOT_ASSESSED 38. No other verdict moved.

Revocation still works after the edit, which is the thing that would have been easy to break: gutting every CREATE POLICY and ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY out of the applied chain moves V8.3.1 from PASS to NOT_ASSESSED, and restoring the chain returns it to PASS. The condition #4855 installed is still load-bearing.
The diff is a single deleted line. The file was rewritten through JSON.parse/stringify with two-space indent and a trailing newline, matching its existing formatting exactly, so nothing else moved.
